title: Branch cleanup cycle
description: Cycle-level metadata for one stale branch and pull request cleanup run. Exactly one instance per cycle, stored at cycles/<cycle_id>/cycle.json on the branch-cleanup-state branch.

schema_version.description: Incremented only on a breaking change. Readers must refuse a version they do not know rather than best-effort parse it.

cycle_id.description: ISO date of Day 0. Sortable, and unambiguous if a cycle is re-run within one quarter.

repo.description: owner/name of the repository this cycle scanned. The store is self-contained per repo; this field exists so a record read in isolation is unambiguous.

state.description: Lifecycle position of the cycle. Makes the scheduled finalization in PLGQEES-2893 idempotent: a re-run against a finalized cycle is a no-op rather than a second deletion pass.

dry_run.description: True for the report-only cycles in the PLGQEES-2822 rollout. Finalization must refuse to delete or rename when true. Without this, pilot cycles are indistinguishable from real ones in the history.

voting_closes_at.description: End of the voting window. Day 7 finalization runs at or after this instant.

jira_issue_key.description: Key of the per-cycle ticket created by PLGQEES-2891. Null until that step runs.

slack_thread_ts.description: Timestamp id of the Day 0 Slack thread, used by PLGQEES-2892 to update messages in place.

candidate_count.description: Number of records under cycles/<cycle_id>/branches/. Lets a reader detect a truncated or partially written cycle without walking the tree.

criteria.description: The thresholds actually applied by this cycle's scan, recorded rather than implied so that 'why was this a candidate' does not depend on what the workflow config happened to be that quarter.

pr_stale_after_days.description: Days without commits, comments, or reviews before an open PR is itself a candidate. Replaces the blanket open-PR exclusion in the original PLGQEES-2890 scope.

exempt_prefixes.description: Ref prefixes skipped before staleness is computed. Each must end in a slash so that 'archive/' cannot match a branch named 'archived-experiment'.

skip_protected.description: Skip refs carrying a ruleset deletion rule. This is what keeps main and branch-cleanup-state out of the candidate set without a hardcoded exception.

skipped.description: Branch names excluded before candidacy, by reason. Names only, not records: cheap to store, and enough to answer 'was my branch even considered'.
